raw.query:
WITH current_eda AS (
  SELECT e.*
  FROM provenance.eda_metric e
  JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = e.run_id
  WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL
), burst_ranked AS (
  SELECT window_bin, signal, value_num AS cv2,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY window_bin ORDER BY value_num DESC) AS signal_rank,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY window_bin) AS denominator
  FROM current_eda
  WHERE script = 'q_multires_tails' AND stat = 'cv2'
    AND signal IN ('images','ctx','gen','requests')
), burst_summary AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS image_windows,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signal='images' AND signal_rank=1) AS image_rank1_windows,
         MIN(denominator) FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS denominator,
         MIN(cv2) FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS image_cv2_min,
         MAX(cv2) FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS image_cv2_max,
         STRING_AGG(window_bin || ':' || cv2::text || '(rank ' || signal_rank::text || '/' || denominator::text || ')', ', ' ORDER BY regexp_replace(window_bin,'[^0-9]','','g')::int)
           FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS per_window
  FROM burst_ranked
), persistence_raw AS (
  SELECT signal, value_num AS hurst, NULL::double precision AS acf_halflife_minutes
  FROM current_eda
  WHERE metric_path IN ('images.hurst_from_beta','requests.hurst_from_beta','ctx_signal.hurst_from_beta','gen_signal.hurst_from_beta')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN metric_path='acf_1min.img_halflife_minutes' THEN 'images'
              WHEN metric_path='acf_1min.req_halflife_minutes' THEN 'requests'
              WHEN metric_path='ctx_signal.acf_halflife_minutes' THEN 'ctx'
              WHEN metric_path='gen_signal.acf_halflife_minutes' THEN 'gen' END,
         NULL::double precision, value_num
  FROM current_eda
  WHERE metric_path IN ('acf_1min.img_halflife_minutes','acf_1min.req_halflife_minutes','ctx_signal.acf_halflife_minutes','gen_signal.acf_halflife_minutes')
), persistence AS (
  SELECT signal, MAX(hurst) AS hurst, MAX(acf_halflife_minutes) AS acf_halflife_minutes
  FROM persistence_raw GROUP BY signal
), persistence_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hurst DESC) AS hurst_rank,
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY acf_halflife_minutes DESC) AS halflife_rank,
            COUNT(*) OVER () AS denominator
  FROM persistence
), persistence_summary AS (
  SELECT MAX(hurst) FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS image_hurst,
         MAX(hurst_rank) FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS image_hurst_rank,
         MAX(acf_halflife_minutes) FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS image_halflife_minutes,
         MAX(halflife_rank) FILTER (WHERE signal='images') AS image_halflife_rank,
         MAX(denominator) AS denominator,
         MAX(acf_halflife_minutes) FILTER (WHERE signal<>'images') AS max_competitor_halflife_minutes,
         STRING_AGG(signal || ':H=' || hurst::text || ',half=' || acf_halflife_minutes::text, ', ' ORDER BY hurst DESC) AS per_signal
  FROM persistence_ranked
), forecast_grouped AS (
  SELECT variate, resolution, mode, span, AVG(wape) AS mean_wape
  FROM provenance.forecast_metrics
  WHERE wape IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY variate, resolution, mode, span
), forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY resolution,mode,span ORDER BY mean_wape DESC) AS wape_rank,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY resolution,mode,span) AS denominator
  FROM forecast_grouped
), forecast_summary AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE variate='images') AS image_groups,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE variate='images' AND wape_rank=1) AS image_highest_wape_groups,
         MIN(denominator) FILTER (WHERE variate='images') AS denominator,
         MIN(mean_wape) FILTER (WHERE variate='images') AS image_mean_wape_min,
         MAX(mean_wape) FILTER (WHERE variate='images') AS image_mean_wape_max
  FROM forecast_ranked
), version_check AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.run_id) AS current_nonsuperseded_eda_runs,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema='provenance' AND c.table_name='forecast_metrics' AND (c.column_name IN ('is_current','is_superseded','superseded_by') OR c.column_name ILIKE '%effective%')) AS forecast_version_columns
  FROM current_eda e
  WHERE e.run_id IN ('eda:q_multires_tails','eda:f_fourier','eda:d_signals','eda:g_ctx','eda:m_gen_and_global')
)
SELECT b.*, p.image_hurst, p.image_hurst_rank, p.image_halflife_minutes, p.image_halflife_rank,
       p.denominator AS persistence_denominator, p.max_competitor_halflife_minutes, p.per_signal,
       f.image_groups AS forecast_groups, f.image_highest_wape_groups, f.denominator AS forecast_denominator,
       f.image_mean_wape_min, f.image_mean_wape_max,
       v.current_nonsuperseded_eda_runs, v.forecast_version_columns
FROM burst_summary b CROSS JOIN persistence_summary p CROSS JOIN forecast_summary f CROSS JOIN version_check v
raw.observed: Across 5 current, non-superseded EDA runs, images rank 1/4 for CV² in 19/19 windows (2.3349592931395273–25.713805501910283), rank 1/4 for Hurst at 0.9324861626791896, and rank 1/4 for ACF half-life at 69 minutes versus a maximum competitor value of 15 minutes. Images also have the highest mean WAPE in 20/20 resolution-mode-span groups among 4 variates (0.6485710488162792–2.3057966194433606); forecast_metrics has 0 version/effective columns.
raw.claimed: The signals that carry the vision pool's load are not only the burstiest but the most persistent.
raw.evidence: Current EDA data independently place image load first at every measured burstiness window and first under both persistence measures; higher forecast WAPE reflects prediction difficulty and does not contradict temporal persistence.
